title: Memorandum (internal memo)
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Professional Ethics and Skills drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer.

parts.why: The organisation's name and address. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The title. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

The date, sender, recipient and subject. When a memo goes from a higher authority to a lower one, 'From' comes first; from a lower to a higher authority, 'To' comes first. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The message, short and direct. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The sender's name and title. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Who receives copies. Source: Professional Ethics drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Organisation
fields.question: Which organisation is the memo from?

fields.label: First line (From or To)
fields.question: From a higher to a lower authority write 'From: General Manager'; from a lower to a higher authority write 'To: Managing Director'.

fields.label: Second line (To or From)
fields.question: The other line, for example 'To: All Drivers'.

fields.label: Sender's title
fields.question: Their title, for example General Manager.

fields.label: Copies to
fields.question: Who gets copies? One per box.

changeLog.note: First draft for legal review, from the course drafting materials in the knowledge base.
